correctness.rationale: The cited convex halving-pair lemma gives delta=perimeter/(2 h_min). Opposite boundary halves of normalized trapezoid are exhausted by base-base, base-leg, and leg-leg regimes; direct chord quadratics give h=min{sqrt(S²-x²),1+x²/S,sqrt[(S-x)(S+1)²/(2S)] where 1<=S<=1+2x}. The ratio functions A,B decrease in imbalance x, C increases; their triple balance has quintic P(S) with P(1)=-8, P(2)=109 and Descartes unique positive root. Exact symbolic derivatives of the two crossing branches have opposite sign. Independent symbolic factor and 2,000 random trapezoid global lower-bound checks reproduced the constant. The proof (not finite grid) establishes uniqueness and quantifies all x in [0,1), S>x.
residual_risks: Finite experiments are supplementary; global claim depends on the specific analytic steps in RESULT.md.
